commission: D-002: self-update/repair deferred; install is fresh signed download. The later disposition must draw the DR-107/G18 generation-rollback versus self-update-rollback boundary and address file 02's unexercised updates inventory entry.
ownerWhoMustRecord: Release + platform owners (file 08 DR-110). Coordinator may draft.
decision: Defer DR-110 wholly from the architecture preview. Preview install is a fresh signed download. Self-update, repair-media trust, crash-injected repair, and revocation-aware rollback of an installed core are OUT.
boundaryWithDR107G18: DR-G18 / DR-107 cover generation, lock, lease, and removal crash-safety for preview local state. They do not cover self-update or repair-media rollback of the distribution core. This deferral is that boundary. File 02's updates inventory entry stays unexercised in the preview.
whatMayBeDesigned: Fresh signed download/install of the preview core and the TypeScript component.
DR-G18 crash-safety for preview generation/lock/lease/removal, which is not self-update.
whatMustNotBePretendedSettled: Revocation-aware rollback of an already-installed core

condition2EffectIfOwnerRecorded: May count as the explicit preview deferral D-002 requires for DR-110, including the G18-versus-self-update boundary. Does not SATISFY the row.
whatThisDoesNotDo: Does not name a repair-media harness.
